props.name: variant
props.description: Emphasis level of the action. Pick by the action's standing in the view, not decoration. Prefer primary, then outline, then secondary.

values.name: primary
values.whenToUse: The one action the view exists for. Only one per view or dialog.

values.name: outline
values.whenToUse: A real alternative beside the primary, such as Cancel.

values.name: secondary
values.whenToUse: An alternative where outline genuinely cannot be used.
values.whenToNotUse: As a default second button. Reach for outline first.

values.name: ghost
values.whenToUse: Quiet actions in a toolbar, table row or card header.

values.name: ai
values.whenToUse: An action initiated by or handing off to AI.
values.whenToNotUse: With a theme. It takes none.

values.name: link
values.whenToUse: An action that must read as inline text.
values.whenToNotUse: For navigation, use Link. Takes no theme.

values.name: transparent
values.whenToUse: Button behaviour with no chrome at all.
values.whenToNotUse: With a theme. It takes none.

props.name: theme
props.description: Semantic meaning of the action, not decoration. Only applies to primary, secondary, outline and ghost. ai, link and transparent ignore it. primary with theme default renders the brand colour.

values.name: success
values.whenToUse: A positive confirmation, such as Approve.

values.name: danger
values.whenToUse: Destroys data or cannot be undone, such as Delete.
values.whenToNotUse: Reversible actions. Overusing red teaches people to ignore it.

props.name: size
props.description: Height, padding and gap. 2xs and 3xs always render icon-only and drop any text child, so pass aria-label.

values.name: 2xs
values.whenToUse: Very tight spaces and composite components.
values.whenToNotUse: When the button needs a visible text label.

values.name: 3xs
values.whenToUse: Very tight spaces and composite components.
values.whenToNotUse: When the button needs a visible text label.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Renders a full pill shape instead of the default corner radius.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Renders a square button holding one icon and no text. Pass exactly one IconV2 child and an aria-label. Any other child is discarded.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled. A disabled button leaves the tab order, so explain why in visible text.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button. Don't set it for an async onClick, which handles it for you. Sets no aria-busy, so announce long waits yourself.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, plus any IconV2 elements shown beside it. Icons are children, not props.

props.name: tooltipProps
props.description: Tooltip title, content, side, align or open. Required with iconOnly unless ignoreIconOnlyTooltip is set. A tooltip does not name the button, so still pass aria-label.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler. Return a promise and the button shows loading until it settles. Handle rejection inside the handler.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Required for every icon-only button, including 2xs and 3xs.

props.name: ignoreIconOnlyTooltip
props.description: Opts out of the icon-only tooltip requirement, for a button whose meaning is clear from adjacent text. It does not remove the need for an accessible name.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders the single child (such as a router Link) instead of a <button>. The child owns the semantics, so disabled and type stop applying.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button type. Defaults to 'button', not 'submit'. Pass 'submit' deliberately for a form's submit control.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only, such as width, margin or grid placement. Colour, radius and size have their own props.
